title: Score Studio
summary: The Score panel is for composing with notation: a grand staff or piano roll, notes, lyrics, key selection, playback and an AI coach.
alternateQueries: How do I move a note?

blocks.text: Score Studio lets you compose with notation, lyrics, teaching cues and AI-assisted revision. Show the grand staff or the piano roll.

blocks.definition: Add Note adds a note; Remove Note removes the selected one. Note Up and Note Down move the selected note by a semitone; Beat Left and Beat Right move it earlier or later. A lyric syllable can be typed for the selected note.
Choose the key (for example C Major, A Minor, G Major).
An assistant section for teaching and revising the composition.
